 Gold Prices Decline in Visakhapatnam 
 People planning to purchase gold in Visakhapatnam received some relief on Wednesday as gold prices recorded another drop in the local market.
 According to city-wise gold rate data published for November 18, the price of 22-carat gold decreased to ₹12,215 per gram from ₹12,470 on November 17. Similarly, 24-carat gold fell to ₹13,326 per gram from ₹13,604.
 The decline reflects the recent downward movement in gold prices. However, the actual selling price at jewellery stores may vary depending on the jeweller and applicable charges.

 These rates exclude GST, making charges and other applicable charges.
 Gold Prices Fall Compared with Previous Day 
 The 22-carat gold rate dropped by ₹255 per gram compared with November 17, while the 24-carat rate declined by ₹278 per gram.
 For someone purchasing 10 grams of gold, this represents a difference of ₹2,550 in 22-carat gold and ₹2,780 in 24-carat gold compared with the previous day's indicative rates.
 The movement is relevant for families planning jewellery purchases, particularly with wedding and festive shopping contributing to demand in the local market.
 What Is Behind the Gold Price Movement? 
 Gold prices in India are influenced by several factors, including international gold market movements, the value of the Indian rupee against the US dollar, import costs and domestic demand.
 Changes in global economic conditions and investor demand for safe-haven assets can also affect gold prices.
 However, the daily price movement in Visakhapatnam should not be attributed to any single factor without supporting market data.
 What Should Gold Buyers in Vizag Know? 
 Although the decline may offer some relief to buyers, the final jewellery bill will be higher than the basic gold value.
 Making charges, applicable GST and other charges are added to the purchase price. Buyers should compare rates across jewellery stores and check the BIS hallmark and HUID details before purchasing gold.
 Since gold rates can change during the day, customers are advised to confirm the latest price with their preferred jeweller before visiting the store.
